description: Deliver the next/image drop-in wiring for the home hero plus a pointer naming exactly where the photo drops in — path, filename, and alt-text convention. The aspect-ratio container receives a next/image fill element with appropriate sizes/priority; a graceful placeholder renders until the real asset is filled in. Other pages stay text-only this round.
title: Wire the home hero as a drop-in photo slot with a pointer
acceptance_criteria: The home-hero zone renders via next/image (fill) with priority and correct sizes, sourced from a single known asset path.
With no real photo present, the graceful placeholder still renders; no layout shift between placeholder and a dropped-in photo.
A pointer doc states the exact path/filename and the alt-text convention for the hero photo.
Dropping a file at that path swaps the placeholder for the photo with no code change — verifiable with a test image.
